id: does not push again when nothing changed
reason: Fake-timer test advances 6h past the first push; `today` is derived from the real (faked) Date, so whenever the suite happens to start within 6h of UTC midnight the interval push lands on a new calendar day, the dedup key changes, and push fires a second time. Unrelated to PR #1324's roster-scope changes (neither this test nor the component it covers are touched by that diff); flakes only depending on wall-clock run time.
